name: JW.ORG
description: Browse and stream public JW.ORG videos as a Jellyfin Channel.
overview: Adds a JW.ORG Channel to Jellyfin. The plugin browses public JW.ORG video categories and streams selected MP4 files directly from JW CDN URLs without downloading media locally.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Adds a JW.ORG Channel to Jellyfin for browsing and streaming public JW.ORG video content with multi-language support.
